common_visual_observations: Every original native frame was opened separately. Numeric 00, 01 and 02 and both ellipsis separators remain readable in every complete dense source control; no label is accepted by cover identity or by state strings alone.

The selected black inverse moves from the first configured source to the second and third in their respective final frames. All-source count 25, Bookshelf, More and the full unsubmitted draft remain directly visible.
The open English keyboard is separated by its full top rule. Letter rows, mode controls, space and Search action remain in bounds; the empty-bookshelf text is readable above the keyboard.
